title: It's falling apart already
text: It's falling apart already. I bought this bench in November but it started falling apart last month in May, 6 months later.  The bottom rack has fallen out and its not as sturdy as when I first put it together.  To be honest, I am not surprised.  You get what you pay for.

product_metadata.title: Homemaid Living Bamboo 3 Tier Shoe Rack Bench, Premium Shoe Organizer or Entryway Bench, Perfect for Shoe Cubby, Entry Bench, Bathroom Bench, Entryway Organizer, Hallway or Living Room(Black)

Also ideal for showers, bathrooms, tubs, and other places with water.

Easy to assemble - The free standing wooden bamboo shoe rack bench is easy to assemble, sturdy, and durable. It comes with all parts and tools necessary for assembly. Please refer to the third video for detailed instructions

Beautiful look - Water-resistant bamboo that wipes down easily with a damp cloth. This entryway shoe rack bench makes everything look beautiful and it will match compliments almost any décor. It fits perfectly in your hallway, closet, living room, bedroom, bathroom, patio, kitchen, mudroom, entryway, foyer or more
